Messages.Author: Sacha
Messages.Body:
"GreySeer" <e...@i.think.not> wrote in message news:<uclhsuq...@news.supernews.com>...


What about say, The Beast's rush, followed up by Mask of a Thousand
Faces, untap rush again, mask ect?

Ie:
Beast rushes---Ox Mask's becoming the acting minion, Smash!!
Beast Rushes----Cailean Mask's becoming the acting minion, catch!
(sewer lid)

Repeat until crispy.

I think it's legal as the modifying Ox or Cailean are now the acting
minion. However the Mask has a disclaimer in the text:

Mask of a Thousand Faces [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Action Modifier

Discipline: Obfuscate

Only usable by a <ready,> untapped vampire other than the acting
minion [who is capable of performing the action].
[obf] Untap the acting minion and tap this vampire instead. Now this
vampire is the acting minion. The action resumes where it left off.
[OBF] As above, with +1 stealth

Ox and Cailean don't have the built in rush abillity.
Does the text prevent this abusive combo?
[who is capable of performing the action].

Pc.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Sacha" said:




He already has.

Mask cannot be used to mask an action if the Masking vampire is
not capable of taking that action, nor if any action modifiers
have been played on this action that could not have been played
if the Masking vampire were the acting minion. (Not counting
blood that has already been spent.) [RTR 19980623]
